title: Norwegian Vegetable Pie
description: A savory pie filled with a mix of vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is a hearty and flavorful take on a classic dish.

ingredients.name: Vegetables
ingredients.notes: mixture of diced potatoes, zucchini, and onions

ingredients.name: Pie Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of salt, pepper, and nutmeg

instructions: Roll out the flaky crust and place in a pie dish.
In a pan, sauté the chopped carrots and mixed vegetables until tender.
Add the pie spices and stir to combine.
Pour the vegetable mixture into the pie crust.
Dot the top of the filling with melted butter.
Roll out the remaining crust and use to cover the pie.
Crimp the edges to seal and cut a few slits in the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
